files.name: main.py
files.code:
import numpy as np
from sklearn.datasets import load_breast_cancer
from sklearn.linear_model import LogisticRegression
from sklearn.metrics import precision_recall_curve, precision_score, recall_score, roc_auc_score
from sklearn.model_selection import train_test_split
from sklearn.pipeline import make_pipeline
from sklearn.preprocessing import StandardScaler

X, y = load_breast_cancer(return_X_y=True)
y = 1 - y                                     # 1 = ác tính (lớp cần bắt)
X_tr, X_te, y_tr, y_te = train_test_split(X, y, test_size=0.3, stratify=y, random_state=0)
model = make_pipeline(StandardScaler(), LogisticRegression(max_iter=1000)).fit(X_tr, y_tr)
proba = model.predict_proba(X_te)[:, 1]
print("ROC-AUC:", round(roc_auc_score(y_te, proba), 3))

# Mỗi ngưỡng cho một cặp (precision, recall)
prec, rec, thr = precision_recall_curve(y_te, proba)

# Mục tiêu nghiệp vụ: recall >= 0.98 (bỏ sót ung thư rất đắt) -> ngưỡng cao nhất thoả mãn
ok = np.where(rec[:-1] >= 0.98)[0]
t = thr[ok[-1]]
pred = (proba >= t).astype(int)
print("ngưỡng chọn:", round(float(t), 3), "| recall:", round(recall_score(y_te, pred), 3), "| precision:", round(precision_score(y_te, pred), 3))

prompt.vi: Huấn luyện pipeline StandardScaler + LogisticRegression trên ung thư vú (1 = ác tính, tức y = 1 − target; chia 70/30, stratify, random_state=0). In ROC-AUC của tập kiểm tra làm tròn 2 chữ số.
prompt.en: Train a StandardScaler + LogisticRegression pipeline on the breast cancer data (1 = malignant, i.e. y = 1 − target; 70/30 split, stratify, random_state=0). Print the test-set ROC-AUC rounded to 2 digits.

from sklearn.datasets import load_breast_cancer
from sklearn.linear_model import LogisticRegression
from sklearn.metrics import roc_auc_score
from sklearn.model_selection import train_test_split
from sklearn.pipeline import make_pipeline
from sklearn.preprocessing import StandardScaler
X, y = load_breast_cancer(return_X_y=True)
y = 1 - y
X_tr, X_te, y_tr, y_te = train_test_split(X, y, test_size=0.3, stratify=y, random_state=0)
m = make_pipeline(StandardScaler(), LogisticRegression(max_iter=1000)).fit(X_tr, y_tr)
print(round(roc_auc_score(y_te, m.predict_proba(X_te)[:, 1]), 2))

prompt.vi: Với mô hình trên, quét ngưỡng 0.5, 0.3, 0.1 trên xác suất. In True nếu recall KHÔNG giảm khi hạ ngưỡng (recall(0.1) >= recall(0.3) >= recall(0.5)), ngược lại False.
prompt.en: With the model above, sweep thresholds 0.5, 0.3, 0.1 on the probability. Print True if recall does NOT decrease as the threshold drops (recall(0.1) >= recall(0.3) >= recall(0.5)), else False.

from sklearn.datasets import load_breast_cancer
from sklearn.linear_model import LogisticRegression
from sklearn.metrics import recall_score
from sklearn.model_selection import train_test_split
from sklearn.pipeline import make_pipeline
from sklearn.preprocessing import StandardScaler
X, y = load_breast_cancer(return_X_y=True)
y = 1 - y
X_tr, X_te, y_tr, y_te = train_test_split(X, y, test_size=0.3, stratify=y, random_state=0)
m = make_pipeline(StandardScaler(), LogisticRegression(max_iter=1000)).fit(X_tr, y_tr)
proba = m.predict_proba(X_te)[:, 1]
r = [recall_score(y_te, (proba >= t).astype(int)) for t in (0.5, 0.3, 0.1)]
print(r[2] >= r[1] >= r[0])
